[2023-08-15T14:32:07] Mateo Alvarez (Customer): Hi, I've been having issues with customizing the AI Cirku-Tech tool for our projects. How can we resolve this?
[2023-08-15T14:39:45] Nkosana Mthembu (Agent): Hello Mateo! Thanks for reaching out. I see you're having a tailoring problem with AI Cirku-Tech. Let's address this together.
[2023-08-15T14:41:16] Mateo Alvarez (Customer): We need more flexibility for the customizations we require. Can you help with this?
[2023-08-15T14:47:03] Nkosana Mthembu (Agent): Certainly! The best approach is to ensure comprehensive training. I can grant you access to our full suite of training modules. Does that work for you?
[2023-08-15T14:49:27] Mateo Alvarez (Customer): Yes, that sounds great. How soon can I access these training modules?
[2023-08-15T14:51:55] Nkosana Mthembu (Agent): I will initiate access for you immediately. You should have the access details within the hour.
[2023-08-15T14:52:38] Mateo Alvarez (Customer): Perfect, thank you so much for your assistance!
[2023-08-15T14:54:02] Nkosana Mthembu (Agent): You're welcome, Mateo! If you need further help, feel free to reach out. Have a great day!
